proof_obligations.C1_REFINEMENT_STABILITY_IMPLIES_EQUITABI: At termination, vertices of one WL1 color have equal neighbor-color multiplicities.
proof_obligations.C2_TYPE_LABEL_SEPARATION: Variable and constraint nodes cannot share a stable WL1 color because refinement retains prior color information seeded by distinct labels.
proof_obligations.C3_SINGLETON_CONSTRAINT_NEIGHBOR_EQUALIT: If u and v have the same stable color and every constraint color is singleton, u and v have identical adjacency to every constraint node.
proof_obligations.C4_IDENTICAL_INCIDENT_CONSTRAINT_SET: C3 implies every residual constraint contains u iff it contains v.
proof_obligations.C5_SCOPE_SET_PRESERVATION: Swapping u and v therefore leaves every constraint scope set unchanged.
proof_obligations.C6_R000_R111_COORDINATE_SYMMETRY: The allowed tuple relation generated by an all-positive 3-clause or all-negative 3-clause is invariant under every permutation of its three coordinates.
proof_obligations.C7_RELATION_PRESERVATION: C5 plus C6 leaves each normalized constraint key unchanged under transposition u<->v.
proof_obligations.C9_DIRECT_EXACT_PREDICATE_TRUE: The frozen is_exact_transposition_automorphism returns true without executing it as a selector gate.
proof_obligations.C10_SCOPE_THEOREM_COMPOSITION: If additionally 3*2^(n-2)<=L^2, the already-frozen scope theorem implies E3 admission without needing a direct exact-check call.
